Setting.Description: Defines the shown columns of CIs in the link table complex view, depending on the CI class. Each entry must be prefixed with the class name and double colons (i.e. Computer::). There are a few CI-Attributes that common to all CIs (example for the class Computer: Computer::Name, Computer::ZTSMStatus, Computer::CreateTime). To show individual CI-Attributes as defined in the CI-Definition, the following scheme must be used (example for the class Computer): Computer::HardDisk::1, Computer::HardDisk::1::Capacity::1, Computer::HardDisk::2, Computer::HardDisk::2::Capacity::1. If there is no entry for a CI class, then the default columns are shown.

Setting.Name: AgentCustomerInformationCenter::Backend###0060-CIC-GovernanceObjectCustomerCompany
Setting.Description: Parameters for the dashboard backend of the customer company Governance Object overview of the agent interface . "Limit" is the number of entries shown by default. "Group" is used to restrict the access to the plugin (e. g. Group: admin;group1;group2;). "Default" determines if the plugin is enabled by default or if the user needs to enable it manually. "CacheTTLLocal" is the cache time in minutes for the plugin. "GovernanceObjectKey" is used to specify which reference field is used for a Governance Object class (Key=Class, Value=DynamicFieldName).

Setting.Name: AgentCustomerUserInformationCenter::Backend###0060-CUIC-GovernanceObjectCustomerUser
Setting.Description: Parameters for the dashboard backend of the customer company Governance Object overview of the agent interface . "Limit" is the number of entries per Governance Object class shown by default. "Group" is used to restrict the access to the plugin (e. g. Group: admin;group1;group2;). "Default" determines if the plugin is enabled by default or if the user needs to enable it manually. "CacheTTLLocal" is the cache time in minutes for the plugin. "GovernanceObjectKey" is used to specify which reference field is used for a Governance Object class (Key=Class, Value=DynamicFieldName).
